# CAPSUS - Sustainable Development Consulting

CAPSUS is a mission-oriented boutique consulting firm, established in 2009, specialized in sustainability issues in the energy, environmental management and urban sectors. We solve questions with grounded innovative solutions that foresee a better future for coming generations.

## Core Expertise
* Sustainable Urban Planning and Building Design
* Environmental Studies and Assessments
* Dissemination and Capacity Development on Sustainability
* Design and Evaluation of Public Policies

## Methodology & Approach
A bottom-up approach is taken with urban and environmental management projects, and a top-down angle with research, development, and public policy implementation projects. 

## Project Portfolio
A complete, interactive database of our ~140 global projects is available at /portfolio-en.html.
